THE LATEST VALUE MENTIONED FOR THE FENBY ACCOUNT'S OVERDRAFT LIMIT WAS 9,200. HOWEVER, THE QUERY ASKS FOR THE "MONTHLY ALLOWANCE," WHICH HAS NEVER BEEN SPECIFIED IN THE CONVERSATION. THE ONLY FIGURE PROVIDED WAS FOR THE "OVERDRAFT LIMIT." IF YOU MEAN THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, IT IS 9,200. IF YOU MEAN A DIFFERENT METRIC CALLED "MONTHLY ALLOWANCE," THAT FIGURE HAS NOT BEEN MENTIONED. BASED ON THE PROMPT'S INSTRUCTION TO KEEP TRACK OF FIGURES THE USER MENTIONS, AND SINCE "MONTHLY ALLOWANCE" WAS NOT MENTIONED, BUT "OVERDRAFT LIMIT" WAS, I WILL ASSUME YOU ARE REFERENCING THE ONLY FINANCIAL FIGURE PROVIDED.

THE FIGURE IS 9,200.
